items.text: Born February 5 in the Nishijin district of Kyoto, Japan, a fifth-generation descendant of weavers
Immigrated to the U.S.; worked as a seamstress for Seattle clothing companies
Opened the clothing design shop 'Ikko' in Seattle's Greenwood neighborhood; designed for eight years, often using antique kimono silks
Studied dyeing methods in Japan; taught shibori to children and adults at the Aki Matsuri / Cherry Blossom Festival for some 20 years
